findings.description: Requesting a product that does not exist (?id=99) shows 'ITEM NOT FOUND' but the body is garbled: it carries telephone-IVR text ('your call could not be completed as dialled... dial 0... This is a recording. 4 T 1.'), a price of '$√-1', a stock dog photo, and a live 'Add to basket' button.
repro: Observe the 'ITEM NOT FOUND' panel: unrelated IVR copy, a '$√-1' price, a product photo and an enabled Add to basket button

notes: Tested all seven journeys on desktop (1280px) and a 375px width. Sign-in, product list (six products, photos, names, descriptions, prices), sort orders (A-Z, Z-A, low-high, high-low), add/remove from list and detail, detail-vs-list consistency for all six products, cart contents and badge, checkout totals (subtotal, 8% tax, total), finish/confirmation, logout and redirect-when-logged-out all behaved correctly. Login errors for empty and wrong credentials read correctly. No horizontal overflow at 375px. No console errors or HTTP 4xx/5xx during the flows. Button text reads 'Add to basket' and the cart page is 'Your Basket' rather than 'Add to cart'; treated as deliberate copy and not reported. Login inputs rely on aria-label and placeholder with no visible label element; treated as stock behaviour and not reported. Not tested: performance under load, multi-tab sessions, and the Reset App State and About menu items.

cost.notes: estimate from 87608 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0009-$0.0105
